quote: Blossoming Rootwarden's Focus should now disenchant into Midnight materials.
notes: Official item-specific correction for input item 259349. Previous March 10 player report observed The War Within outputs; this hotfix states intended material expansion, not a numeric drop rate. Do not infer actual eligible item variants, exact output item IDs, quantities, or patch version.
affects: Blossoming Rootwarden's Focus (item 259349); expansion identity of disenchant materials
wording: Blossoming Rootwarden's Focus should now disenchant into Midnight materials.

quote: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods should now contain gear that disenchants into more relevant materials.
notes: Blizzard specifies gear obtained at levels 10–79 yields The War Within disenchant materials and at levels 80–90 yields Midnight materials. Applies to newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods (item 135539); not proof about older crates, actual item versions or per-material yields. Both level bands belong to one official hotfix, not independent samples.
affects: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods (item 135539) reward gear: player levels 10–79 -> The War Within materials; levels 80–90 -> Midnight materials
wording: Newly created Crate of Battlefield Goods should now contain gear that disenchants into more relevant materials.
